answer_1.quote: This work delves into studying the decoding process of LLMs for generating recommendations.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the model's top‑K recommendation performance (accuracy), we use two commonly used metrics: Hit Ratio (HR@K) and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG@K). ... We used BLEU to measure the textual similarity among recommendation results, and Entropy to assess the category diversity.
